title: Cache cleanup: reconcile the overnight report
summary: The overnight cache report disagrees with the morning metrics in both directions. Trace a small Python service, reconcile the counts, and verify its replay checks before operations plans capacity.
task: Investigate the overnight cache-count discrepancies and restore an accurate report across the replay checks.

company.notes: Two connected lifecycle defects across log replay and in-memory eviction; no syntax error or crash.

phase2.spec_patch: Ops also needs pinned entries to survive the sweep: a pinned entry is never evicted, even once it is expired, because those keys are hand-warmed and must stay resident. The pinned flag is already the optional fourth column on every write. Keep the same header and per-row format.
